name: t01_gray_otsu
change: Baseline: grayscale + global Otsu threshold, every connected component is an egg
why: Eggs are the brightest objects in most images; a simplest-possible reference point

name: t02_cleanup
change: Gaussian blur 7, open 5 / close 15, fill holes, keep blobs 1.5%-50% of the image
why: t01 output is thousands of specks; dev eggs cover 2.6%-38% of the image (SAM masks), so size alone removes most noise
decision: keep (needed for shape filters; mIoU drop exposes egg-background merging)

name: t03_lab_whiteness
change: Score = Lab L - 2*chroma instead of grayscale
why: Eggs are white (low chroma); pink bowls, leaves, orange tubs and purple cloth are bright but colourful

name: t03b_hsv_whiteness
change: Score = V*(1-S) in HSV (alternative whiteness measure to t03)
why: Compare with the Lab version; HSV saturation is unstable for dark pixels

name: t04_shape_filter
change: Reject blobs with solidity < 0.85 or ellipse-fit IoU < 0.75
why: Dev eggs: solidity p5 0.97, ellipse IoU p5 0.89 (min 0.66 when occluded); background blobs are irregular
decision: discard (inst precision up, recall collapses: single threshold is the limit)

name: t05_sweep
change: Replace the single threshold with a 24-level threshold sweep over the gray image, both polarities; candidates scored by ellipse IoU x Canny edge support, greedy non-overlapping pick (min 1, max 6 eggs)
why: t02-t04 show one global threshold can't isolate eggs on white or bright backgrounds (egg merges with them) or when backlit (egg darker); some threshold isolates the egg in almost every image

name: t06_edge_cut
change: Cut every sweep mask along dilated Canny edges before finding blobs (rim given back afterwards)
why: diagnose_sweep on t05: 42/50 failures are generation failures; the egg stays connected to a neighbouring region of similar brightness at every threshold, but there is a visible edge between them

name: t07b_relax_shape
change: min_solidity 0.85 -> 0.8, min_ellipse_iou 0.75 -> 0.65, max_area_frac 0.5 -> 0.6
why: several t06 generation failures (ash, occluded, large close-up eggs) are just outside the shape/size limits; dev GT minimum ellipse IoU is 0.66

name: t07a_canny_wide
change: Canny sigma 0.33 -> 0.6 (lower low-threshold, more edges)
why: white-on-white outlines (bag, tray, paper) are faint; auto-Canny around the median misses them, so the egg still leaks into the background

name: t08_smoothness
change: Add a second sweep channel: smoothness = 255 - 8*local std (11x11); candidates from both channels compete
why: eggs are smooth while ash, leaves, patterned cloth and keyboards are textured; gives the sweep an independent chance where brightness alone merges egg and background
decision: keep (oracle IoU 0.67->0.78; selection now the bottleneck)

name: t09_shape_contrast
change: Candidate quality = shape^2 * min(1, contrast/50) * (0.6 if touching image border), replacing ellipse_iou * edge_support; min_quality 0.35 -> 0.3
why: after t08 the egg is usually among the candidates but loses at selection (17 failures). On dev candidates, ellipse IoU (AUC 0.976) and ring contrast (0.941) separate eggs far better than edge support (0.702); the combination gets AUC 0.988 vs 0.760

name: t10a_ellipse
change: Replace each selected blob by its fitted ellipse
why: t09 precision 0.91 but recall 0.68: selected blobs are usually a correct but partial egg (shadowed side cut off); eggs are near-ellipses (dev GT ellipse IoU median 0.976), so the fit should restore the missing part

name: t10b_grabcut
change: GrabCut refinement: eroded blob = sure egg, 15 px band = unsure, 5 iterations
why: same under-segmentation as t10a, but let colour models decide the boundary instead of assuming a perfect ellipse (occluded eggs are not ellipses)

name: t11_nested_07
change: After picking a blob, upgrade it to the largest candidate containing >=90% of it whose quality is >= 0.7 x the pick's
why: t10b loss breakdown: 51% of lost IoU is partial eggs, 29/31 under-segmented (precision 0.96, recall 0.61); the sweep makes nested blobs (bright cap inside whole egg) and the cap often wins on ellipse fit

name: t11_nested_085
change: After picking a blob, upgrade it to the largest candidate containing >=90% of it whose quality is >= 0.85 x the pick's
why: t10b loss breakdown: 51% of lost IoU is partial eggs, 29/31 under-segmented (precision 0.96, recall 0.61); the sweep makes nested blobs (bright cap inside whole egg) and the cap often wins on ellipse fit

name: t11_nested_05
change: Nested upgrade with quality ratio 0.5 (looser than 0.7)
why: 0.7 beat 0.85 (+0.031 vs +0.024 mIoU); check whether a looser ratio recovers more partial eggs

name: t11_nested_03
change: Nested upgrade with quality ratio 0.3 (looser than 0.7)
why: 0.7 beat 0.85 (+0.031 vs +0.024 mIoU); check whether a looser ratio recovers more partial eggs

name: t11_nested_015
change: Nested upgrade with quality ratio 0.15
why: mIoU still rising at 0.3 while precision falls; find where the curve turns

name: t12a_band30
change: GrabCut unsure band 15 -> 30 px
why: remaining partial eggs: GrabCut cannot grow past the 15 px band, so a blob covering half an egg stays half

name: t12b_band30_limit
change: GrabCut band 30 px, growth limited to the blob's fitted ellipse x1.3
why: keep the extra reach of t12a but stop leaks into skin/walls of similar colour (#20, #155)
decision: discard (limit blocks more partial-egg growth than leaks it stops)

name: t12c_band45_limit
change: GrabCut band 45 px, growth limited to fitted ellipse x1.5
why: check whether even more reach helps once growth is bounded

name: t13a_ch_hsv
change: Third sweep channel: HSV whiteness V*(1-S)
why: 12 dev images still have the wrong/missing egg (42% of lost IoU), mostly because the egg never forms a clean blob; whiteness separates white eggs from coloured surroundings (pink bowl, hand) that gray and smoothness merge

name: t13b_ch_lab
change: Third sweep channel: Lab whiteness L - 2*chroma
why: same as t13a with the Lab whiteness measure

name: t14_no_forced_egg
change: min_eggs 1 -> 0: output nothing when no candidate reaches min_quality
why: in the missed-egg images the forced pick is a background blob (#11, #106, #117, #125); it scores IoU 0 either way, but adds a false-positive egg
decision: discard (-0.17 mIoU: many true eggs score below min_quality; every image has >=1 egg)

name: t15_revert_leaks
change: After GrabCut, per egg: revert to the pre-GrabCut blob if the area grew >2x or the result's ellipse IoU < 0.8
why: t13b worst cases #32, #20, #155: egg correctly selected, then GrabCut floods white paper / skin / wall; the ellipse growth limit (t12b) was too blunt and hurt partial eggs overall, so only undo GrabCut where its output is implausible
decision: discard (no effect: the leaks happen before GrabCut, in the nested upgrade)

name: t16_nest_cap25
change: Nested upgrade may grow a pick at most 2.5x in area
why: t15 found the #32/#20/#155 leaks happen before GrabCut: the nested upgrade (ratio 0.3) swaps a correct egg for a 4-11x larger egg+paper / egg+hand region that contains it

name: t16_nest_cap4
change: Nested upgrade may grow a pick at most 4x in area
why: t15 found the #32/#20/#155 leaks happen before GrabCut: the nested upgrade (ratio 0.3) swaps a correct egg for a 4-11x larger egg+paper / egg+hand region that contains it
